text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm Tokai Teio! Nice to meetcha!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You know, I want to become the strongest 
and coolest Umamusume, just like the 
President!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"I gotta win a whole bunch for that, 
though —well, leave it to me! Nishishi."

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
